_README: fp16 patch table for Krea 2 on Kaggle T4 (Turing / SM75, no bf16).
These strings are VERIFIED -- taken from a working notebook, not guessed.
krea2_main.py hardcodes bf16 and its three offload.load_model_data calls
pass no preprocess_sd, so weights arrive bf16 and die on Turing kernels.
Patch 1 comments out the dtype override. Patches 2-4 wrap each loader with
a preprocess_sd that casts every floating tensor to the active dtype.
krea_server.py also runs a post-load sweep, so a NO MATCH costs load time,
not correctness. Verify with: python scripts/krea_server.py --probe

patches.name: dtype_override
patches.replace: # dtype = torch.bfloat16 # Patched for FP16 on T4
patches.note: The hardcoded bf16 override. Commenting it out lets the fp16 dtype passed into load_model win.

patches.name: transformer_preprocess
patches.note: Chains onto the existing preprocess_sd rather than replacing it -- that one does quanto unpacking and must still run first.

patches.name: text_encoder_preprocess
patches.note: Qwen3-VL language model. No preprocess_sd upstream, so this adds one.

patches.name: vae_preprocess
patches.note: A bf16 VAE fails at decode -- after you already paid for every diffusion step.
